terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.acceptanceContent: By accessing or using ZeFile ("the Service"), you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use the Service. ZeFile reserves the right to update these terms at any time, and your continued use of the Service constitutes acceptance of any changes.
terms.servicesContent: ZeFile is a secure file transfer platform that enables users to upload, share, and deliver files to recipients. The Service includes file hosting, payment processing for paid transfers, download link generation, and email notifications. Files are stored on secure cloud infrastructure and delivered via encrypted connections.
terms.accountsContent: To use certain features, you must create an account using a valid email address or phone number. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials. You agree to provide accurate information and to update it as necessary. ZeFile may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms or are inactive for an extended period.
terms.fileTransfersContent: You retain ownership of all files you upload to ZeFile. By uploading files, you grant ZeFile a limited license to store, process, and deliver your files to designated recipients. You are solely responsible for the content you upload and must ensure it does not violate any laws or third-party rights. ZeFile does not monitor or review uploaded content but reserves the right to remove content that violates these terms.
terms.paymentsContent: ZeFile offers both free and paid plans. For paid transfers, recipients must complete payment before downloading files. Payments are processed through our third-party payment provider (Paystack). A platform service fee is applied based on your subscription tier. Refunds are available within the refund window specified in our refund policy. All prices are displayed in the currency applicable to your region.
terms.intellectualPropertyContent: The ZeFile platform, including its design, logos, and software, is the intellectual property of ZeFile. You may not copy, modify, distribute, or reverse engineer any part of the Service. User-uploaded content remains the property of the respective users.
terms.prohibitedUseContent:
You agree not to use ZeFile to:
- Upload or distribute illegal, harmful, or infringing content
- Send malware, viruses, or malicious files
- Engage in fraud, phishing, or deceptive practices
- Circumvent security measures or access restrictions
- Use automated tools to scrape or abuse the Service
- Violate any applicable laws or regulations
terms.limitationContent: ZeFile is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. To the maximum extent permitted by law, ZeFile shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages arising from your use of the Service. Our total liability shall not exceed the amount you have paid to ZeFile in the preceding 12 months.
terms.terminationContent: You may close your account at any time through your account settings. ZeFile may suspend or terminate your account for violations of these terms, fraudulent activity, or extended inactivity. Upon termination, your files will be deleted according to our data retention policy. Any outstanding payments or payouts will be processed according to our payment terms.
terms.changesContent: ZeFile reserves the right to modify these Terms of Service at any time. We will notify users of significant changes via email or an in-app notification. Your continued use of the Service after changes are posted constitutes your acceptance of the revised terms.
terms.contactContent: If you have questions about these Terms of Service, please contact us at support@zefile.io.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.collectionContent: We collect information you provide directly when creating an account (email address, phone number, name), using the Service (file metadata, transfer details, payment information), and interacting with our platform (usage data, device information, IP addresses). We use cookies and similar technologies to improve your experience.
privacy.useContent:
We use your information to:
- Provide and maintain the Service
- Process file transfers and payments
- Send transactional emails (OTP codes, transfer notifications, receipts)
- Improve and personalize your experience
- Detect and prevent fraud or security threats
- Comply with legal obligations

We do not sell your personal information to third parties.
privacy.storageContent: Files uploaded to ZeFile are stored on secure cloud infrastructure with encryption in transit. Files are retained until the transfer expires or is deleted by the sender. Expired transfers are automatically removed according to our retention schedule. Account data is retained as long as your account is active and for a reasonable period thereafter for legal and business purposes.
privacy.thirdPartyContent: ZeFile uses third-party services to operate, including cloud file storage, email delivery, payment processing, content delivery, and analytics. Each service has its own privacy policy. We only share the minimum data necessary for each service to function.
privacy.cookiesContent: We use essential cookies for authentication and security (session tokens, CSRF protection). We use analytics cookies to understand how users interact with the Service. You can control cookie preferences in your browser settings. The Service requires essential cookies to function properly.
privacy.rightsContent:
Under GDPR and applicable data protection laws, you have the right to:
- Access your personal data
- Correct inaccurate data
- Request deletion of your data
- Export your data in a portable format
- Withdraw consent for data processing
- Object to processing of your data

You can exercise these rights through your account settings or by contacting us at support@zefile.io.
privacy.securityContent: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your data, including encryption in transit (TLS/HTTPS), secure authentication, rate limiting, CSRF protection, and Content Security Policy headers. We regularly review and update our security practices.
privacy.childrenContent: ZeFile is not intended for use by children under the age of 16. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If we become aware that a child has provided personal information, we will take steps to delete it.
privacy.changesContent: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of significant changes via email or an in-app notification. We encourage you to review this policy periodically.
privacy.contactContent: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or your personal data, please contact us at support@zefile.io.
